WITH 
-- All sessions with transactions in February 2017
transaction_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    device.deviceCategory
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) h WHERE h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL)
),
-- First transaction date and device category for each visitor in Feb 2017
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date as first_transaction_date,
    deviceCategory,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date) as rn
  FROM transaction_sessions
),
-- First visit date in Feb 2017 for each visitor (any session)
first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
)
SELECT 
  fv.fullVisitorId,
  fv.first_visit_date,
  ft.first_transaction_date,
  DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ft.first_transaction_date), PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fv.first_visit_date), DAY) as days_elapsed,
  ft.deviceCategory
FROM first_visit fv
JOIN first_transaction ft ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId AND ft.rn = 1
ORDER BY days_elapsed DESC, fullVisitorId

WITH traffic_source_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source as traffic_source,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 as total_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) as h,
    UNNEST(h.product) as p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY trafficSource.source
),
top_source AS (
  SELECT traffic_source
  FROM traffic_source_revenue
  ORDER BY total_revenue_millions DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
daily_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', s.date)) as day,
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 as daily_rev
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s,
    UNNEST(s.hits) as h,
    UNNEST(h.product) as p
  WHERE s._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND s.trafficSource.source = (SELECT traffic_source FROM top_source)
  GROUP BY s.date
),
weekly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(day, WEEK(MONDAY)) as week_start,
    SUM(daily_rev) as weekly_rev
  FROM daily_revenue
  GROUP BY week_start
),
monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(day, MONTH) as month_start,
    SUM(daily_rev) as monthly_rev
  FROM daily_revenue
  GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT traffic_source FROM top_source) as traffic_source,
  (SELECT MAX(daily_rev) FROM daily_revenue) as max_daily_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(weekly_rev) FROM weekly_revenue) as max_weekly_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(monthly_rev) FROM monthly_revenue) as max_monthly_product_revenue_millions

WITH session_data AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    totals.pageviews,
    SAFE_CAST(totals.transactions AS INT64) as transactions,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
      WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(h.product) AS p WHERE p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(p.productRevenue AS INT64) > 0)
    ) as has_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as session_month,
    pageviews,
    CASE 
      WHEN transactions >= 1 AND has_product_revenue THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN transactions IS NULL AND NOT has_product_revenue THEN 'non-purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END as session_type
  FROM session_data
  WHERE (transactions >= 1 AND has_product_revenue) OR (transactions IS NULL AND NOT has_product_revenue)
)
SELECT 
  session_month,
  session_type,
  AVG(pageviews) as avg_pageviews_per_visitor
FROM classified
GROUP BY session_month, session_type
ORDER BY session_month, session_type

-- Final answer: the top non-YouTube product purchased by visitors who also bought YouTube products in July 2017
WITH yt_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) LIKE '%youtube%'
),
visitor_products AS (
  SELECT s.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName, p.productQuantity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND s.fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM yt_buyers)
  AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
  AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
  AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT v2ProductName, SUM(productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM visitor_products
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_incidents.incidents_2016`
  WHERE descript = 'PUBLIC INTOXICATION'
  GROUP BY date
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(daily_count) as mean_count,
    STDDEV(daily_count) as stddev_count
  FROM daily_counts
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.date,
    dc.daily_count,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) as z_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) DESC) as rn
  FROM daily_counts dc
  CROSS JOIN stats s
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', date) as date
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 2

WITH hit_details AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitId, visitStartTime, date,
         h.hitNumber, h.time, h.type,
         h.page.pagePath,
         LEAD(h.time) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY h.hitNumber) AS next_time,
         LEAD(h.page.pagePath) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY h.hitNumber) AS next_pagePath
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`, UNNEST(hits) AS h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
    AND LOWER(trafficSource.campaign) LIKE '%data share%'
    AND h.type = 'PAGE'
),
home_hits AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitId, 
         pagePath AS home_pagePath,
         time AS home_time,
         next_time,
         next_pagePath
  FROM hit_details
  WHERE pagePath LIKE '/home%'
),
next_page_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    next_pagePath,
    COUNT(*) AS visit_count
  FROM home_hits
  WHERE next_pagePath IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY next_pagePath
  ORDER BY visit_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
max_time AS (
  SELECT 
    SAFE_CAST(
      SAFE_DIVIDE(MAX(next_time - home_time), 1000) AS INT64
    ) AS max_time_seconds
  FROM home_hits
  WHERE next_time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  np.next_pagePath,
  mt.max_time_seconds
FROM next_page_counts np, max_time mt

WITH top_source AS (
  SELECT trafficSource.source
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY trafficSource.source
  ORDER BY SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) / 1000000.0 as monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY month, trafficSource.source
)
SELECT 
  m.source as traffic_source,
  ROUND(MAX(m.monthly_revenue_millions) - MIN(m.monthly_revenue_millions), 2) as monthly_diff_millions
FROM monthly m
JOIN top_source ts ON m.source = ts.source
GROUP BY m.source

WITH henley_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*`, UNNEST(hits) AS hit, UNNEST(hit.product) AS prod
  WHERE prod.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
)
SELECT p.v2ProductName AS product_name, SUM(COALESCE(p.productQuantity, 0)) AS total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*` s
JOIN henley_buyers hb ON s.fullVisitorId = hb.fullVisitorId
, UNNEST(s.hits) AS hit
, UNNEST(hit.product) AS p
WHERE p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
  AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH 
users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201231' AND '20210107'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
),
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users_2day u2 WHERE u2.user_pseudo_id = u7.user_pseudo_id)

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    new_confirmed,
    LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prev_new_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0
    AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-04-30'
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) AS mm_dd,
  new_confirmed,
  prev_new_confirmed,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - prev_new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed) AS growth_rate
FROM daily
WHERE prev_new_confirmed IS NOT NULL AND prev_new_confirmed > 0
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  provider_city,
  SUM(total_discharges) AS city_total_discharges,
  SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) / SUM(total_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
  AND provider_city IN ('NEW YORK', 'BOSTON', 'SPRINGFIELD')
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY city_total_discharges DESC

-- Final verification: get the top 20 Citi Bike routes by trip count in 2016,
-- find those faster than yellow taxis (by matching rounded coordinates to 3 decimals),
-- and return the one with the longest average bike duration.

WITH route_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_name,
        end_station_name,
        start_station_latitude,
        start_station_longitude,
        end_station_latitude,
        end_station_longitude,
        COUNT(*) as trip_count,
        AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
        AND tripduration > 0
    GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name, 
             start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude,
             end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude
    ORDER BY trip_count DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
taxi_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
        ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
        AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
    WHERE trip_distance > 0
        AND pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
        AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL
        AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
        AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3), ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3),
             ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3), ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3)
)
SELECT 
    rs.start_station_name,
    rs.end_station_name,
    ROUND(rs.avg_bike_duration, 3) as avg_bike_duration
FROM route_stats rs
LEFT JOIN taxi_averages ta 
    ON ROUND(rs.start_station_latitude, 3) = ta.start_lat 
    AND ROUND(rs.start_station_longitude, 3) = ta.start_lon
    AND ROUND(rs.end_station_latitude, 3) = ta.end_lat
    AND ROUND(rs.end_station_longitude, 3) = ta.end_lon
WHERE ta.avg_taxi_duration IS NOT NULL 
    AND rs.avg_bike_duration < ta.avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY rs.avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
),
with_minutes AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    trip_seconds / 60.0 AS trip_minutes_exact,
    ROUND(trip_seconds / 60.0) AS trip_minutes,
    fare
  FROM filtered
),
with_quantile AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_minutes,
    trip_minutes_exact,
    fare,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_minutes) AS quantile_group
  FROM with_minutes
)
SELECT 
  quantile_group,
  CAST(ROUND(MIN(trip_minutes_exact)) AS INT64) AS min_trip_duration_minutes,
  CAST(ROUND(MAX(trip_minutes_exact)) AS INT64) AS max_trip_duration_minutes,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  AVG(fare) AS average_fare
FROM with_quantile
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY quantile_group

SELECT 
    ac.geo_id as census_tract,
    ROUND(AVG(i.transaction_amt), 2) as avg_donation_amount,
    ac.median_income
FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20` i
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` cw
    ON i.zip_code = cw.zip_code
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` ac
    ON cw.census_tract_geoid = ac.geo_id
WHERE i.state = 'NY'
    AND cw.census_tract_geoid LIKE '36047%'
GROUP BY ac.geo_id, ac.median_income
ORDER BY ac.geo_id

WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    p.state_code,
    c.condition_status_code,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot, 1.0) * c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted) as subplot_acres,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 0.0) * COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0.0)) as macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    AND c.state_code = p.state_code
    AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
  WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
    AND p.inventory_year = 2012
    AND c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, p.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT evaluation_group, evaluation_type, evaluation_description, state_code, condition_status_code, macroplot_acres, subplot_acres,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM condition_acres
)
SELECT evaluation_group, evaluation_type, condition_status_code, evaluation_description, CAST(state_code AS STRING) as state_code, macroplot_acres, subplot_acres
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH under20 AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    SUM(population) AS pop_under_20
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific`
  WHERE year = 2020 AND age BETWEEN 0 AND 19
  GROUP BY country_name
)
SELECT 
  u.country_name,
  u.pop_under_20,
  m.midyear_population,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(u.pop_under_20, m.midyear_population) * 100 AS pct_under_20
FROM under20 u
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population` m
  ON u.country_name = m.country_name AND m.year = 2020
ORDER BY pct_under_20 DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    country_name,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cumulative_recovered, cumulative_confirmed) * 100, 2) as recovery_rate
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data` 
WHERE date = '2020-05-10' 
  AND aggregation_level = 0 
  AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000
  AND cumulative_recovered IS NOT NULL
  AND cumulative_recovered <= cumulative_confirmed
ORDER BY recovery_rate DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH daily_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date,
    SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) AS temp_f,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS wdsp_knots,
    SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) AS prcp_in
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290' 
    AND year = '2019' 
    AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
    AND SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) != 9999.9
    AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
    AND SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) != 99.99
),
converted AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    ROUND((temp_f - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(wdsp_knots * 0.514444, 1) AS wdsp_ms,
    ROUND(prcp_in * 2.54, 1) AS prcp_cm
  FROM daily_data
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    temp_c,
    wdsp_ms,
    prcp_cm,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wdsp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prcp_ma8
  FROM converted
),
with_lags AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    temp_c,
    wdsp_ms,
    prcp_cm,
    temp_ma8,
    wdsp_ma8,
    prcp_ma8,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag1,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag2,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag3,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag4,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag5,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag6,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag7,
    LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS temp_ma8_lag8,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag1,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag2,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag3,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag4,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag5,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag6,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag7,
    LAG(wdsp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS wdsp_ma8_lag8,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag1,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag2,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag3,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag4,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag5,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag6,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag7,
    LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prcp_ma8_lag8
  FROM with_ma
)
SELECT 
  date,
  ROUND(temp_c, 1) AS temp_c,
  ROUND(wdsp_ms, 1) AS wdsp_ms,
  ROUND(prcp_cm, 1) AS prcp_cm,
  ROUND(temp_ma8, 1) AS temp_ma8,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8, 1) AS wdsp_ma8,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8, 1) AS prcp_ma8,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag1, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag1,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag2, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag2,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag3, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag3,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag4, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag4,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag5, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag5,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag6, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag6,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag7, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag7,
  ROUND(COALESCE(temp_ma8 - temp_ma8_lag8, 0), 1) AS temp_ma8_diff_lag8,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag1, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag1,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag2, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag2,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag3, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag3,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag4, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag4,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag5, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag5,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag6, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag6,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag7, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag7,
  ROUND(COALESCE(wdsp_ma8 - wdsp_ma8_lag8, 0), 1) AS wdsp_ma8_diff_lag8,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag1, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag1,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag2, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag2,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag3, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag3,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag4, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag4,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag5, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag5,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag6, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag6,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag7, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag7,
  ROUND(COALESCE(prcp_ma8 - prcp_ma8_lag8, 0), 1) AS prcp_ma8_diff_lag8
FROM with_lags
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date
LIMIT 5 OFFSET 77

-- Get the latitude of the final coordinates for the hurricane with the second longest distance
WITH storm_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, iso_time, latitude, longitude,
    ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude) AS geo_point,
    LAG(ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude)) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS prev_geo_point
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA'
),
distances AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, 
    ST_DISTANCE(geo_point, prev_geo_point) AS segment_distance
  FROM storm_tracks
  WHERE prev_geo_point IS NOT NULL
),
storm_distances AS (
  SELECT sid, name, SUM(segment_distance) AS total_distance_meters
  FROM distances
  GROUP BY sid, name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT sid, name, total_distance_meters,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_distance_meters DESC) AS rn
  FROM storm_distances
)
SELECT r.name, r.total_distance_meters, 
       h.latitude AS final_latitude,
       h.longitude AS final_longitude,
       h.iso_time AS final_time
FROM ranked r
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` h 
  ON r.sid = h.sid
WHERE r.rn = 2
  AND h.iso_time = (
    SELECT MAX(iso_time) 
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` 
    WHERE sid = r.sid
  )

WITH chicago AS (
  SELECT 41.8319 AS lat, -87.6847 AS lon
),
stations_with_distance AS (
  SELECT
    s.id,
    s.name,
    s.latitude,
    s.longitude,
    -- Haversine distance in km using acos(-1) for pi
    6371.0 * ACOS(
      LEAST(
        COS(acos(-1) * chicago.lat / 180) * COS(acos(-1) * s.latitude / 180) *
        COS(acos(-1) * s.longitude / 180 - acos(-1) * chicago.lon / 180) +
        SIN(acos(-1) * chicago.lat / 180) * SIN(acos(-1) * s.latitude / 180),
        1.0
      )
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations` s
  CROSS JOIN chicago
)
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  ROUND(distance_km, 2) AS distance_km
FROM stations_with_distance
WHERE distance_km <= 50
ORDER BY distance_km

WITH station_coords AS (
  SELECT station_id, latitude, longitude 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations`
),
station_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.station_id AS start_station_id,
    s2.station_id AS end_station_id,
    ACOS(
      SIN(s1.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * SIN(s2.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) + 
      COS(s1.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * COS(s2.latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * 
      COS((s2.longitude - s1.longitude) * 3.14159265358979 / 180)
    ) * 6371000 AS distance_meters
  FROM station_coords s1
  CROSS JOIN station_coords s2
)
SELECT 
  t.bike_number,
  SUM(sp.distance_meters) AS total_distance_meters
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips` t
JOIN station_pairs sp ON t.start_station_id = sp.start_station_id AND t.end_station_id = sp.end_station_id
GROUP BY t.bike_number
ORDER BY t.bike_number

-- Full solution with station_id as primary key
WITH round_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    start_station_name,
    end_station_id,
    end_station_name,
    starttime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
trip_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    r1.start_station_id,
    r1.start_station_name,
    r1.end_station_id,
    r1.end_station_name,
    r1.starttime,
    COUNT(*) as nearby_trips
  FROM round_trips r1
  JOIN round_trips r2 
    ON r1.start_station_id = r2.start_station_id
    AND ABS(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(r1.starttime, r2.starttime, MINUTE)) <= 2
  GROUP BY r1.start_station_id, r1.start_station_name, r1.end_station_id, r1.end_station_name, r1.starttime
),
group_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    COUNT(*) as num_group_trips
  FROM trip_counts
  WHERE nearby_trips >= 2
  GROUP BY start_station_id
),
total_trips_per_station AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id
),
station_names AS (
  SELECT 
    station_id,
    name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY station_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
  FROM (
    SELECT start_station_id as station_id, start_station_name as name 
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    UNION ALL
    SELECT end_station_id as station_id, end_station_name as name
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  )
  GROUP BY station_id, name
)
SELECT 
  gs.start_station_id,
  sn.name,
  gs.num_group_trips,
  ts.total_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(gs.num_group_trips, ts.total_trips) as proportion
FROM group_trips gs
JOIN total_trips_per_station ts 
  ON gs.start_station_id = ts.end_station_id
JOIN station_names sn
  ON gs.start_station_id = sn.station_id AND sn.rn = 1
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  p_zone.zone_name AS pickup_zone,
  d_zone.zone_name AS dropoff_zone,
  TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND) AS trip_duration_seconds,

    AND tip_amount >= 0
    AND tolls_amount >= 0

    AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
  UNION ALL
  SELECT

    dropoff_datetime,
    passenger_count,
    trip_distance,
    fare_amount,
    extra,
    mta_tax,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    airport_fee,
    total_amount,
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_green_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01'

    AND dropoff_datetime >= '2016-07-01'
    AND dropoff_datetime < '2016-07-08'
    AND passenger_count > 5
    AND trip_distance >= 10
    AND fare_amount >= 0

    AND mta_tax >= 0

    AND tolls_amount >= 0

    AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
) t
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` p_zone 
  ON t.pickup_location_id = p_zone.zone_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` d_zone

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tip_amount,
    t.total_amount,
    z.borough as pickup_borough
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` z
    ON t.pickup_location_id = z.zone_id
  WHERE DATE(t.pickup_datetime) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-07'
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
    AND z.borough NOT IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island')
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
),
trips_with_tip_rate AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_amount = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100
    END as tip_rate
  FROM filtered_trips
),
tip_categories AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    tip_rate,
    CASE 
      WHEN tip_rate = 0 THEN 'no tip'
      WHEN tip_rate > 0 AND tip_rate <= 5 THEN 'Less than 5%'
      WHEN tip_rate > 5 AND tip_rate <= 10 THEN '5% to 10%'
      WHEN tip_rate > 10 AND tip_rate <= 15 THEN '10% to 15%'
      WHEN tip_rate > 15 AND tip_rate <= 20 THEN '15% to 20%'
      WHEN tip_rate > 20 AND tip_rate <= 25 THEN '20% to 25%'
      WHEN tip_rate > 25 THEN 'More than 25%'
    END as tip_category
  FROM trips_with_tip_rate
),
counts AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    tip_category,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM tip_categories
  GROUP BY pickup_borough, tip_category
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    SUM(trip_count) as total_trips
  FROM counts
  GROUP BY pickup_borough
)
SELECT 
  c.pickup_borough,
  c.tip_category,
  c.trip_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(c.trip_count, t.total_trips) as proportion
FROM counts c
JOIN totals t ON c.pickup_borough = t.pickup_borough
ORDER BY c.pickup_borough, c.tip_category

WITH users_2021 AS (
  SELECT id, creation_date, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(creation_date), MONTH) as creation_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creation_date) = 2021
),
total_per_month AS (
  SELECT creation_month, COUNT(*) as total_users
  FROM users_2021
  GROUP BY creation_month
),
users_first_q AS (
  SELECT 
    u.id as user_id,
    u.creation_month,
    MIN(q.creation_date) as first_question_date
  FROM users_2021 u
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON u.id = q.owner_user_id
  WHERE q.creation_date BETWEEN u.creation_date AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(u.creation_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY u.id, u.creation_month
),
asked_per_month AS (
  SELECT creation_month, COUNT(*) as asked_within_30
  FROM users_first_q
  GROUP BY creation_month
),
users_answered AS (
  SELECT 
    ufq.user_id,
    ufq.creation_month,
    MIN(a.creation_date) as first_answer_date
  FROM users_first_q ufq
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON ufq.user_id = a.owner_user_id
  WHERE a.creation_date > ufq.first_question_date
    AND a.creation_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(ufq.first_question_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY ufq.user_id, ufq.creation_month
),
answered_per_month AS (
  SELECT creation_month, COUNT(*) as answered_within_30
  FROM users_answered
  GROUP BY creation_month
)
SELECT 
  tpm.creation_month,
  tpm.total_users,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(apm.asked_within_30 * 100.0, tpm.total_users), 2) as pct_asked_within_30,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(upm.answered_within_30 * 100.0, apm.asked_within_30), 2) as pct_answered_after_first_q
FROM total_per_month tpm
LEFT JOIN asked_per_month apm ON tpm.creation_month = apm.creation_month
LEFT JOIN answered_per_month upm ON tpm.creation_month = upm.creation_month
ORDER BY tpm.creation_month

SELECT 
  CAST(year AS INT64) AS year,
  ROUND(CAST(temp AS FLOAT64), 1) AS avg_temp,
  ROUND(CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64), 1) AS avg_wind_speed,
  ROUND(CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64), 2) AS precipitation
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE stn = '725030' AND mo = '06' AND da = '12'
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
ORDER BY year

WITH wa_stations AS (
  SELECT usaf, wban, name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE state = 'WA'
),
rainy_2023 AS (
  SELECT 
    g.stn,
    COUNT(*) AS rainy_days_2023
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
  JOIN wa_stations ws ON g.stn = ws.usaf
  WHERE g.prcp > 0 AND g.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY g.stn
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 150
),
rainy_2022 AS (
  SELECT 
    g.stn,
    COUNT(*) AS rainy_days_2022
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` g
  JOIN wa_stations ws ON g.stn = ws.usaf
  WHERE g.prcp > 0 AND g.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY g.stn
)
SELECT 
  ws.usaf AS station_id,
  MIN(ws.name) AS station_name,
  r2023.rainy_days_2023,
  r2022.rainy_days_2022
FROM rainy_2023 r2023
JOIN rainy_2022 r2022 ON r2023.stn = r2022.stn
JOIN wa_stations ws ON r2023.stn = ws.usaf
WHERE r2023.rainy_days_2023 < r2022.rainy_days_2022
GROUP BY ws.usaf, r2023.rainy_days_2023, r2022.rainy_days_2022
ORDER BY r2023.rainy_days_2023 DESC

WITH annotations_set AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT case_barcode, category, classification
  FROM `isb-cgc.TCGA_bioclin_v0.Annotations`
  WHERE entity_type = 'Patient'
    AND (category = 'History of unacceptable prior treatment related to a prior/other malignancy'
         OR classification = 'Redaction')
),
clinical_set AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT case_barcode
  FROM `isb-cgc.TCGA_bioclin_v0.Clinical`
  WHERE disease_code = 'BRCA'
    AND age_at_diagnosis <= 30
    AND gender = 'FEMALE'
),
filtered_cases AS (
  SELECT c.case_barcode
  FROM clinical_set c
  FULL JOIN annotations_set a ON c.case_barcode = a.case_barcode
  WHERE a.category IS NULL
    AND a.classification IS NULL
),
file_urls AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.case_gdc_id, f.file_gdc_id, g.file_gdc_url
  FROM `isb-cgc.GDC_metadata.rel14_fileData_current` f

),
case_mapping AS (

)
SELECT

  fu.file_gdc_url
FROM filtered_cases fc
JOIN case_mapping cm ON fc.case_barcode = cm.case_barcode
JOIN file_urls fu ON cm.case_gdc_id = fu.case_gdc_id
ORDER BY fc.case_barcode, fu.file_gdc_url

WITH complaint_daily AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2010-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY complaint_date, complaint_type
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_date, SUM(daily_count) as total_daily_count
  FROM complaint_daily
  GROUP BY complaint_date
),
temp_daily AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as weather_date,
    AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2008' AND '2017'
    AND stn IN ('725030', '744860')
    AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY weather_date
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    c.complaint_date,
    c.complaint_type,
    c.daily_count,
    t.avg_temp,
    d.total_daily_count,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c.daily_count * 100.0, d.total_daily_count) as daily_pct
  FROM complaint_daily c
  INNER JOIN temp_daily t ON c.complaint_date = t.weather_date
  INNER JOIN daily_totals d ON c.complaint_date = d.complaint_date
),
complaint_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, SUM(daily_count) as total_complaints
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(daily_count) > 5000
),
correlations AS (
  SELECT 
    j.complaint_type,
    ct.total_complaints,
    COUNT(*) as days_with_temp,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.daily_count) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.daily_count),
      SQRT(
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.avg_temp) - POWER(SUM(j.avg_temp), 2))
        * (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.daily_count * j.daily_count) - POWER(SUM(j.daily_count), 2))
      )
    ) as temp_vs_count_corr,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.daily_pct) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.daily_pct),
      SQRT(
        (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.avg_temp) - POWER(SUM(j.avg_temp), 2))
        * (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.daily_pct * j.daily_pct) - POWER(SUM(j.daily_pct), 2))
      )
    ) as temp_vs_pct_corr
  FROM joined j
  INNER JOIN complaint_totals ct ON j.complaint_type = ct.complaint_type
  GROUP BY j.complaint_type, ct.total_complaints
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  total_complaints,
  days_with_temp,
  ROUND(temp_vs_count_corr, 4) as temp_vs_count_corr,
  ROUND(temp_vs_pct_corr, 4) as temp_vs_pct_corr
FROM correlations
WHERE ABS(temp_vs_count_corr) > 0.5
ORDER BY complaint_type

WITH complaint_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, COUNT(*) as total
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE DATE(created_date) BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 3000
),
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT DATE(created_date) as d, complaint_type, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE DATE(created_date) BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date), complaint_type
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT DATE(created_date) as d, COUNT(*) as total
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE DATE(created_date) BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date)
),
daily_proportions AS (
  SELECT dc.d, dc.complaint_type, SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.cnt, dt.total) as proportion
  FROM daily_complaints dc
  JOIN daily_totals dt ON dc.d = dt.d
),
wind_speed AS (
  SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) as d, SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2011` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2012` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2013` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2014` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2015` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2016` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2017` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2018` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT date, SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2020` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
),
combined AS (
  SELECT dp.complaint_type, dp.proportion, ws.wind_speed
  FROM daily_proportions dp
  JOIN wind_speed ws ON dp.d = ws.d
  WHERE dp.complaint_type IN (SELECT complaint_type FROM complaint_totals)
),
stats AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, 
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(proportion * wind_speed) as sum_xy,
    SUM(proportion) as sum_x,
    SUM(wind_speed) as sum_y,
    SUM(proportion * proportion) as sum_x2,
    SUM(wind_speed * wind_speed) as sum_y2
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
correlations AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, 
    SAFE_DIVIDE(n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y, 
      SQRT((n * sum_x2 - POWER(sum_x, 2)) * (n * sum_y2 - POWER(sum_y, 2)))) as raw_r,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y, 
      SQRT((n * sum_x2 - POWER(sum_x, 2)) * (n * sum_y2 - POWER(sum_y, 2)))), 4) as pearson_r
  FROM stats
)
SELECT complaint_type, raw_r, pearson_r FROM correlations 
WHERE pearson_r IN ((SELECT MAX(pearson_r) FROM correlations), (SELECT MIN(pearson_r) FROM correlations))
ORDER BY pearson_r DESC

WITH monthly_sales AS (

pop AS (

SELECT

WITH station_prcp AS (

weather AS (

WITH species_tree AS (
    SELECT UPPER(species_scientific_name) as upper_scientific, fall_color
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species`
),
count_1995 AS (
    SELECT 
        UPPER(spc_latin) as upper_spc,
        COUNT(*) as cnt_not_dead
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
    WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL 
      AND spc_latin NOT IN ('UNKNOWN LIVE TREES', 'UNKNOWN DEAD TREES', 'UNKNOWN STUMP', 'PLANTING SITE')
      AND status != 'Dead'
    GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
count_2015 AS (
    SELECT 
        UPPER(spc_latin) as upper_spc,
        COUNT(*) as cnt_alive
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
    WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
      AND status = 'Alive'
    GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
species_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        st.upper_scientific,
        st.fall_color,
        COALESCE(c19.cnt_not_dead, 0) as cnt_1995,
        COALESCE(c21.cnt_alive, 0) as cnt_2015,
        COALESCE(c21.cnt_alive, 0) - COALESCE(c19.cnt_not_dead, 0) as diff
    FROM species_tree st
    LEFT JOIN count_1995 c19 ON st.upper_scientific = c19.upper_spc
    LEFT JOIN count_2015 c21 ON st.upper_scientific = c21.upper_spc
    WHERE COALESCE(c19.cnt_not_dead, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(c21.cnt_alive, 0) > 0
)
SELECT 
    fall_color,
    SUM(cnt_1995) as total_1995_not_dead,
    SUM(cnt_2015) as total_2015_alive,
    SUM(diff) as total_change,
    COUNT(*) as num_species
FROM species_diff
GROUP BY fall_color
ORDER BY fall_color

WITH y1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin,
    ANY_VALUE(spc_common) AS spc_common,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Fair', 'Poor') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Dead', 'Stump') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
y2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS spc_latin,
    ANY_VALUE(spc_common) AS spc_common,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Dead', 'Stump') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(a.spc_latin, b.spc_latin) AS spc_latin,
    COALESCE(a.spc_common, b.spc_common) AS spc_common,
    COALESCE(a.total, 0) AS total_1995,
    COALESCE(b.total, 0) AS total_2015,
    COALESCE(a.alive, 0) AS alive_1995,
    COALESCE(b.alive, 0) AS alive_2015,
    COALESCE(a.dead, 0) AS dead_1995,
    COALESCE(b.dead, 0) AS dead_2015,
    COALESCE(b.total, 0) - COALESCE(a.total, 0) AS total_growth,
    COALESCE(b.alive, 0) - COALESCE(a.alive, 0) AS alive_growth,
    COALESCE(b.dead, 0) - COALESCE(a.dead, 0) AS dead_growth
  FROM y1995 a
  FULL OUTER JOIN y2015 b ON a.spc_latin = b.spc_latin
)
SELECT 
  spc_latin,
  spc_common,
  total_1995,
  total_2015,
  alive_1995,
  alive_2015,
  dead_1995,
  dead_2015,
  total_growth,
  alive_growth,
  dead_growth
FROM combined
ORDER BY total_growth DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH 
tracts AS (
  SELECT 
    t.geo_id,
    t.tract_geom,
    c.total_pop,
    c.income_per_capita,
    c.total_pop * c.income_per_capita AS total_income
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr` c
    ON t.geo_id = c.geo_id
),
zip_codes_near AS (
  SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
  WHERE ST_DWITHIN(
    internal_point_geom,
    ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.191667, 47.685833),
    5 * 1609.344
  )
  AND state_code = 'WA'
),
intersections AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    tr.total_pop,
    tr.total_income,
    ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(tr.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)) AS intersection_area,
    ST_AREA(tr.tract_geom) AS tract_area
  FROM tracts tr
  CROSS JOIN zip_codes_near z
  WHERE ST_INTERSECTS(tr.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)
),
allocations AS (
  SELECT 
    zip_code,
    SUM(total_pop * (intersection_area / NULLIF(tract_area, 0))) AS allocated_pop,
    SUM(total_income * (intersection_area / NULLIF(tract_area, 0))) AS allocated_income
  FROM intersections
  GROUP BY zip_code
)
SELECT 
  zip_code,
  ROUND(allocated_pop, 1) AS total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(allocated_income, allocated_pop), 1) AS average_individual_income
FROM allocations
ORDER BY average_individual_income DESC

WITH births AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) as year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as no_morbidity_births,
    SUM(Births) as total_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE Year IN (DATE('2016-01-01'), DATE('2017-01-01'), DATE('2018-01-01'))
    AND Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
    AND County_of_Residence_FIPS NOT LIKE '%999'
  GROUP BY Year, County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
birth_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(no_morbidity_births, total_births) as pct_no_morbidity
  FROM births
),
census_poverty AS (
  SELECT '2015' as census_year, geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2016' as census_year, geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2017' as census_year, geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    br.year,
    br.pct_no_morbidity as y,
    cp.poverty_rate as x
  FROM birth_rates br
  INNER JOIN census_poverty cp 
    ON br.County_of_Residence_FIPS = cp.geo_id
    AND CAST(br.year - 1 AS STRING) = cp.census_year
  WHERE br.pct_no_morbidity IS NOT NULL 
    AND cp.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(x) as sum_x,
    SUM(y) as sum_y,
    SUM(x * x) as sum_x2,
    SUM(y * y) as sum_y2,
    SUM(x * y) as sum_xy
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  year,
  n,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y,
    SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y))
  ) as pearson_correlation
FROM stats
SELECT typeof(body_type), body_type FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2016` LIMIT 3

-- Final query: Get the state with highest timberland acres and highest forestland acres
WITH latest_eval AS (
  SELECT peg.state_code, peg.evaluation_group, peg.evaluation_group_sequence_number
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population_evaluation_group` peg
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population_evaluation_type` pet 
    ON peg.evaluation_group_sequence_number = pet.evaluation_group_sequence_number
  WHERE pet.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY peg.state_code ORDER BY peg.evaluation_group_sequence_number DESC) = 1
),
condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    c.state_code,
    le.evaluation_group,
    c.condition_status_code,
    c.reserved_status_code,
    c.site_productivity_class_code,
    c.proportion_basis,
    p.expansion_factor,
    p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
    p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot,
    CASE 
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 THEN p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 THEN p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
      ELSE 0
    END AS adjusted_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
  JOIN latest_eval le ON p.evaluation_group_sequence_number = le.evaluation_group_sequence_number
),
timberland_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    state_code,
    evaluation_group,
    SUM(adjusted_acres) as total_acres
  FROM condition_acres
  WHERE condition_status_code = 1
    AND reserved_status_code = 0
    AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6
  GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group
  ORDER BY total_acres DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
forestland_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    state_code,
    evaluation_group,
    SUM(adjusted_acres) as total_acres
  FROM condition_acres
  WHERE condition_status_code = 1
  GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group
  ORDER BY total_acres DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
state_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT state_code, state_code_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition`
)
SELECT 
  'timberland' as category,
  CAST(t.state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
  CAST(t.evaluation_group AS STRING) as evaluation_group,
  sn.state_code_name as state_name,
  t.total_acres as total_acres
FROM timberland_stats t
JOIN state_names sn ON t.state_code = sn.state_code
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'forestland' as category,
  CAST(f.state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
  CAST(f.evaluation_group AS STRING) as evaluation_group,
  sn.state_code_name as state_name,
  f.total_acres as total_acres
FROM forestland_stats f
JOIN state_names sn ON f.state_code = sn.state_code

WITH covid_cases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT country_name, country_code, cumulative_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE date = DATE('2020-06-30')
    AND aggregation_level = 0
    AND cumulative_confirmed IS NOT NULL
),
wb_pop AS (
  SELECT country, country_code, year_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country`
  WHERE year_2018 IS NOT NULL AND year_2018 > 0
    AND country_code NOT IN ('WLD','IBT','LMY','MIC','IBD','EAR','LMC','UMC','EAS','LTE','EAP','TEA','TSA','SAS','IDA','OED','HIC','PST','IDX','SSF','TSS','SSA')
)
SELECT 
  c.country_name,
  c.country_code,
  c.cumulative_confirmed,
  p.year_2018 AS population_2018,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.cumulative_confirmed, p.year_2018) * 100, 4) AS percentage_confirmed
FROM covid_cases c
LEFT JOIN wb_pop p ON c.country_name = p.country
WHERE c.country_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY percentage_confirmed DESC

WITH yearly_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date <= '2019-12-31' THEN '2019'
      WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date <= '2020-12-31' THEN '2020'
    END as year,
    AVG(SAFE_CAST(symptom_Anosmia AS FLOAT64)) as avg_anosmia
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_sub_region_2_weekly`
  WHERE sub_region_1 = 'New York' 
    AND sub_region_2 IN ('Bronx County', 'Queens County', 'Kings County', 'New York County', 'Richmond County')
    AND (date >= '2019-01-01' AND date <= '2020-12-31')
    AND symptom_Anosmia IS NOT NULL AND symptom_Anosmia != ''
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2019' THEN avg_anosmia END) as avg_2019,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2020' THEN avg_anosmia END) as avg_2020,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2020' THEN avg_anosmia END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2019' THEN avg_anosmia END)), MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2019' THEN avg_anosmia END)) * 100 as pct_change
FROM yearly_avg

SELECT 
  'United States' AS country,
  AVG(CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64)) AS avg_anxiety_2019,
  AVG(CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64)) AS avg_depression_2019,
  AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END) AS avg_anxiety_2020,
  AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END) AS avg_depression_2020,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END) - AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END),
    AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END)
  ) * 100 AS pct_increase_anxiety,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END) - AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END),
    AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END)
  ) * 100 AS pct_increase_depression
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_country_weekly`
WHERE country_region = 'United States'
  AND date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01'

WITH small_contributions AS (
    SELECT 
        cmte_id,
        transaction_amt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.committee_contributions_2016`
    WHERE entity_tp = 'IND' AND transaction_amt > 0 AND transaction_amt <= 200
),
committee_small_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        cmte_id,
        SUM(transaction_amt) as total_small_dollar
    FROM small_contributions
    GROUP BY cmte_id
    HAVING SUM(transaction_amt) > 0
),
committees_with_candidates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cmte_id
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.candidate_committee_2016`
),
qualifying_committees AS (
    SELECT cst.cmte_id, cst.total_small_dollar
    FROM committee_small_totals cst
    INNER JOIN committees_with_candidates cc ON cst.cmte_id = cc.cmte_id
),
candidate_info AS (
    SELECT 
        qcm.cmte_id,
        cc.cand_id,
        c.cand_name
    FROM qualifying_committees qcm
    INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fec.candidate_committee_2016` cc ON qcm.cmte_id = cc.cmte_id
    INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fec.candidate_2016` c ON cc.cand_id = c.cand_id
),
candidate_names AS (
    SELECT 
        cmte_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cand_id) as num_unique_candidates,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cand_name, ',' ORDER BY cand_name) as candidate_names
    FROM candidate_info
    GROUP BY cmte_id
)
SELECT 
    cm.cmte_nm as committee_name,
    cn.num_unique_candidates,
    cn.candidate_names,
    qcm.total_small_dollar
FROM qualifying_committees qcm
INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fec.committee_2016` cm ON qcm.cmte_id = cm.cmte_id
INNER JOIN candidate_names cn ON qcm.cmte_id = cn.cmte_id
ORDER BY cm.cmte_nm

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_datetime,
    t.dropoff_datetime,
    t.passenger_count,
    t.trip_distance,
    t.fare_amount,
    t.mta_tax,
    t.tip_amount,
    t.tolls_amount,
    t.total_amount,
    t.pickup_location_id,
    tz.borough AS pickup_borough
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
    ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2016-01-01'
    AND t.pickup_datetime < '2016-01-08'
    AND t.dropoff_datetime >= '2016-01-01'
    AND t.dropoff_datetime < '2016-01-08'
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
),
with_tip_rate AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_amount = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount * 100, total_amount)
    END as tip_rate
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT 
  pickup_borough,
  COUNT(*) as total_trips,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN tip_rate = 0 THEN 1 END) as no_tip_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(CASE WHEN tip_rate = 0 THEN 1 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100 as no_tip_percentage
FROM with_tip_rate
GROUP BY pickup_borough
ORDER BY pickup_borough

FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v2_1_1_exomes__chr17`
WHERE reference_name = '17' 
  AND start_position BETWEEN 41191318 AND 41282492
  AND reference_bases = 'C'
  AND alternate_bases[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].alt = 'T'
  AND alternate_bases[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].vep IS NOT NULL
  AND alternate_bases[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].vep[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].SYMBOL = 'BRCA1'
  AND alternate_bases[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].vep[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].Consequence LIKE '%missense_variant%'
ORDER BY start_position ASC

WITH variants AS (
  SELECT 
    reference_name,
    start_position,
    end_position,
    AN,
    alternate_bases
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1`
  WHERE reference_name = 'chr1' AND start_position >= 55039447 AND end_position <= 55064852
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as num_variants,
  (SELECT SUM(ab.AC) FROM variants, UNNEST(variants.alternate_bases) AS ab) as total_ac,
  SUM(AN) as total_alleles,
  (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT v.SYMBOL, ', ' ORDER BY v.SYMBOL) FROM variants, UNNEST(variants.alternate_bases) AS ab, UNNEST(ab.vep) AS v WHERE v.SYMBOL IS NOT NULL) as gene_symbols,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(55064852 - 55039447, COUNT(*)) as mutation_density
FROM variants

WITH accident_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number, 
    consecutive_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT person_number) as person_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN injury_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as severe_injury_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2015`
  WHERE month_of_crash BETWEEN 1 AND 8
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT person_number) > 1
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_accidents,
  SUM(CASE WHEN severe_injury_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as accidents_with_more_than_one_severe,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN severe_injury_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0,
    COUNT(*)
  ) as percentage
FROM accident_stats

WITH mitelman_cases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.CaseNo, c.RefNo
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen` c
  WHERE c.Morph = '3111' AND c.Topo = '0401'
),
mitelman_freq AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN c.Chr = 'chrX' THEN 'X'
      WHEN c.Chr = 'chrY' THEN 'Y'
      ELSE REPLACE(c.Chr, 'chr', '')
    END as Chromosome,
    c.Type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mc.CaseNo) as num_cases
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c
  INNER JOIN mitelman_cases mc ON c.RefNo = mc.RefNo AND c.CaseNo = mc.CaseNo
  GROUP BY Chromosome, c.Type
),
recurrent_freq AS (
  SELECT 
    Chromosome,
    CASE 
      WHEN Abnormality LIKE '+%' THEN 'Gain'
      WHEN Abnormality LIKE '-%' THEN 'Loss'
    END as Type,
    CAST(TotalCases AS INT64) as num_cases
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentNumData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401'
),
combined AS (
  SELECT m.Chromosome, m.Type, m.num_cases as mitelman_freq, r.num_cases as recurrent_freq
  FROM mitelman_freq m
  INNER JOIN recurrent_freq r ON m.Chromosome = r.Chromosome AND m.Type = r.Type
  WHERE m.num_cases >= 5 AND r.num_cases >= 5
)
SELECT 
  Type as aberration_type,
  CORR(mitelman_freq, recurrent_freq) as pearson_correlation,
  COUNT(*) as num_chromosomes
FROM combined
GROUP BY Type

-- The question asks for the top 3 cities with the largest difference, ordered from greatest to least.

WITH epa_1990 AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(city_name) as city_name,
        ROUND(latitude, 2) as lat,
        ROUND(longitude, 2) as lon,
        AVG(arithmetic_mean) as epa_mean
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.air_quality_annual_summary`
    WHERE year = 1990
        AND parameter_name = 'Acceptable PM2.5 AQI & Speciation Mass'
        AND units_of_measure = 'Micrograms/cubic meter (LC)'
        AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY lat, lon
),
openaq_2020 AS (
    SELECT 
        city,
        ROUND(latitude, 2) as lat,
        ROUND(longitude, 2) as lon,
        AVG(value) as openaq_mean
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.openaq.global_air_quality`
    WHERE pollutant = 'pm25'
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM timestamp) = 2020
        AND value > 0
    GROUP BY city, lat, lon
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(NULLIF(e.city_name, ''), o.city) as city,
    ROUND(e.epa_mean - o.openaq_mean, 4) as difference
FROM epa_1990 e
JOIN openaq_2020 o 
    ON e.lat = o.lat 
    AND e.lon = o.lon
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH storm_points AS (
  SELECT 
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude) AS geo_point
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE basin = 'NA' 
    AND season = '2020'
    AND sid = '2020233N14313'
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    geo_point,
    LAG(geo_point) OVER (ORDER BY iso_time) AS prev_geo_point
  FROM storm_points
),
with_distance AS (
  SELECT 
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    geo_point,
    COALESCE(ST_DISTANCE(geo_point, prev_geo_point), 0) / 1000 AS segment_km
  FROM with_prev
)
SELECT 
  iso_time,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  usa_wind,
  SUM(segment_km) OVER (ORDER BY iso_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_distance_km
FROM with_distance
ORDER BY iso_time

-- Calculate total chi-squared statistic
WITH paad_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bcr_patient_uuid, bcr_patient_barcode
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup`
  WHERE acronym = 'PAAD'
),
patient_mutations AS (
  SELECT 
    p.bcr_patient_uuid,
    p.bcr_patient_barcode,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_kras,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
  FROM paad_patients p
  LEFT JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` m
    ON p.bcr_patient_barcode = m.ParticipantBarcode 
    AND m.Study = 'PAAD'
  GROUP BY p.bcr_patient_uuid, p.bcr_patient_barcode
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    has_kras,
    has_tp53,
    COUNT(*) as observed
  FROM patient_mutations
  GROUP BY has_kras, has_tp53
),
margins AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(observed) as grand_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_pos_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_neg_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_pos_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_neg_total
  FROM contingency
)
SELECT 
  SUM(
    POW(c.observed - 
      CASE 
        WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_pos_total * m.tp53_pos_total, m.grand_total)
        WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 0 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_pos_total * m.tp53_neg_total, m.grand_total)
        WHEN c.has_kras = 0 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_neg_total * m.tp53_pos_total, m.grand_total)
        WHEN c.has_kras = 0 AND c.has_tp53 = 0 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_neg_total * m.tp53_neg_total, m.grand_total)
      END, 2) / 
    CASE 
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_pos_total * m.tp53_pos_total, m.grand_total)
      WHEN c.has_kras = 1 AND c.has_tp53 = 0 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_pos_total * m.tp53_neg_total, m.grand_total)
      WHEN c.has_kras = 0 AND c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_neg_total * m.tp53_pos_total, m.grand_total)
      WHEN c.has_kras = 0 AND c.has_tp53 = 0 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(m.kras_neg_total * m.tp53_neg_total, m.grand_total)
    END
  ) as chi_squared_statistic
FROM contingency c
CROSS JOIN margins m

-- Final calculation: net difference between patients with both KRAS and TP53 mutations vs neither
WITH all_paad_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`

      WHEN pm.has_kras IS NULL AND pm.has_tp53 IS NULL THEN 'neither'
      WHEN pm.has_kras = 0 AND pm.has_tp53 = 0 THEN 'neither'
      ELSE 'one_only'
    END as status
  FROM all_paad_patients ap

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'both' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'neither' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as net_difference

WITH cohort_cases AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CaseNo
    FROM `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen`
    WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401'
),
total_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_cases FROM cohort_cases
),
band_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CaseNo, c.Chr, c.Start, c.`End`, c.Type, c.ChrOrd,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.cytoband_name) as num_bands
    FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c
    JOIN cohort_cases co ON c.CaseNo = co.CaseNo
    JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` b ON c.Chr = b.chromosome
        AND c.Start < b.hg38_stop 
        AND c.`End` > b.hg38_start
    GROUP BY c.CaseNo, c.Chr, c.Start, c.`End`, c.Type, c.ChrOrd
),
classified AS (
    SELECT 
        bc.CaseNo,
        b.chromosome,
        b.cytoband_name,
        b.hg38_start,
        b.hg38_stop,
        bc.ChrOrd,
        CASE 
            WHEN bc.num_bands > 1 AND bc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 'Amplification'
            WHEN bc.num_bands = 1 AND bc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 'Gain'
            WHEN bc.num_bands = 1 AND bc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 'Loss'
            WHEN bc.num_bands > 1 AND bc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 'Homozygous_deletion'
        END as event_type
    FROM band_counts bc
    JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` b ON bc.Chr = b.chromosome
        AND bc.Start < b.hg38_stop 
        AND bc.`End` > b.hg38_start
),
band_event_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        chromosome,
        cytoband_name,
        hg38_start,
        hg38_stop,
        ChrOrd,
        event_type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CaseNo) as case_count
    FROM classified
    GROUP BY chromosome, cytoband_name, hg38_start, hg38_stop, ChrOrd, event_type
)
SELECT 
    bec.chromosome,
    bec.cytoband_name,
    bec.hg38_start,
    bec.hg38_stop,
    bec.event_type,
    bec.case_count as number,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(bec.case_count * 100.0, tc.total_cases), 2) as frequency
FROM band_event_counts bec
CROSS JOIN total_count tc

WITH chr13_loss AS (

  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start < 48481890 AND `End` > 48303751
),

  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss'
    AND Start < 7687490 AND `End` > 7668421
),
chr11_gain AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain'
    AND Start < 108369102 AND `End` > 108223067
),
matching_clones AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c13.RefNo, c13.CaseNo, c13.InvNo, c13.Clone
  FROM chr13_loss c13
  INNER JOIN chr17_loss c17 
    ON c13.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c17.Clone
  INNER JOIN chr11_gain c11 
    ON c13.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c11.Clone
),
chr13_agg AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, 
    MIN(ChrOrd) as chr13_ChOrd, MIN(Start) as chr13_Start, MIN(`End`) as chr13_End
  FROM chr13_loss
  GROUP BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
),
chr17_agg AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone,
    MIN(ChrOrd) as chr17_ChOrd, MIN(Start) as chr17_Start, MIN(`End`) as chr17_End
  FROM chr17_loss
  GROUP BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
),
chr11_agg AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone,
    MIN(ChrOrd) as chr11_ChOrd, MIN(Start) as chr11_Start, MIN(`End`) as chr11_End
  FROM chr11_gain
  GROUP BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
)

  mc.RefNo,

  kc.CloneShort,

  c17_agg.chr17_End,
  c11_agg.chr11_ChOrd,
  c11_agg.chr11_Start,
  c11_agg.chr11_End

INNER JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` kc

trips_jan1 AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015`
  WHERE DATE(pickup_datetime) = '2015-01-01'

trips_with_zip AS (

jan1_counts AS (

  FROM jan1_counts

WITH question_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    q.id as question_id,
    q.view_count,
    q.owner_user_id as question_owner_id,
    q.accepted_answer_id,
    a.id as answer_id,
    a.owner_user_id as answer_owner_id,
    a.score as answer_score,
    a.parent_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON q.id = a.parent_id
),
question_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    question_id,
    view_count,
    question_owner_id,
    accepted_answer_id,
    answer_id,
    answer_owner_id,
    answer_score,
    COALESCE(SUM(answer_score) OVER (PARTITION BY question_id), 0) as total_answer_scores,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY question_id ORDER BY answer_score DESC) as score_rank
  FROM question_answers
  WHERE answer_id IS NOT NULL
),
associated_pairs AS (
  -- Condition 1: Question owner (exclude NULL owners)
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, view_count, question_owner_id as user_id
  FROM question_answers
  WHERE question_owner_id IS NOT NULL
  
  UNION DISTINCT
  
  -- Condition 2: Accepted answer owner
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, view_count, answer_owner_id as user_id
  FROM question_answers
  WHERE accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL AND answer_id = accepted_answer_id
  
  UNION DISTINCT
  
  -- Condition 3: Answer score > 5
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, view_count, answer_owner_id as user_id
  FROM question_answers
  WHERE answer_score > 5
  
  UNION DISTINCT
  
  -- Condition 4: Answer score > 20% of total answer scores AND > 0
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, view_count, answer_owner_id as user_id
  FROM question_stats
  WHERE answer_score > 0 
    AND CAST(answer_score AS FLOAT64) > 0.2 * CAST(total_answer_scores AS FLOAT64)
  
  UNION DISTINCT
  
  -- Condition 5: Among top 3 highest-scoring answers
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, view_count, answer_owner_id as user_id
  FROM question_stats
  WHERE score_rank <= 3
),
user_totals AS (
  SELECT user_id, SUM(view_count) as combined_view_count
  FROM associated_pairs
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT 
  ut.user_id,
  u.display_name,
  ut.combined_view_count
FROM user_totals ut
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON ut.user_id = u.id
ORDER BY ut.combined_view_count DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH user_answers AS (

  WHERE pa.owner_user_id = 1908967

),
answer_votes AS (
  SELECT 
    ua.answer_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.vote_type_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvote_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.vote_type_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted_count
  FROM user_answers ua
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.votes` v ON v.post_id = ua.answer_id
  GROUP BY ua.answer_id
),
answer_tags AS (

  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON pq.id = ua.question_id
  JOIN answer_votes av ON av.answer_id = ua.answer_id
  WHERE pq.tags IS NOT NULL AND pq.tags != ''
),
tagged_votes AS (
  SELECT 
    answer_id,
    tag,
    upvote_count,
    accepted_count
  FROM answer_tags,
  UNNEST(SPLIT(tags, '|')) AS tag

WITH questions AS (

    id as question_id,

    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM creation_date) as dow,

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
  WHERE creation_date >= '2021-01-01' AND creation_date < '2022-01-01'
),
answered_within_1hr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    q.question_id,
    q.dow,
    q.day_name
  FROM questions q
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON a.parent_id = q.question_id
  WHERE TIMESTAMP_DIFF(a.creation_date, q.question_date, SECOND) BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
),
day_totals AS (
  SELECT dow, day_name, COUNT(*) as total_questions
  FROM questions
  GROUP BY dow, day_name
),
day_answered AS (
  SELECT dow, COUNT(DISTINCT question_id) as answered_within_1hr
  FROM answered_within_1hr
  GROUP BY dow
)
SELECT 
  d.day_name,
  d.total_questions,
  COALESCE(a.answered_within_1hr, 0) as answered_within_1hr,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(a.answered_within_1hr, 0), d.total_questions) * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM day_totals d

WITH qualifying_questions AS (

WITH gdp_data AS (

    AND id.year = 2020
    AND id.value IS NOT NULL
    AND cd.region IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    gdp_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY gdp_value) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS cnt
  FROM gdp_data
)
SELECT 
  region,

FROM ranked

GROUP BY region
ORDER BY median_gdp DESC

WITH zip_bg_overlap AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, b.geo_id as bg_geo_id, 
         SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)), b.area_land_meters) as overlap_ratio
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_blockgroups.us_blockgroups_national` b
    ON ST_INTERSECTS(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)
  WHERE z.state_fips_code = '08'
    AND ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)) > 0
),
zip_bank_counts AS (
  SELECT zip_code, COUNT(*) as bank_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fdic_banks.locations`
  WHERE state = 'CO'
  GROUP BY zip_code
),
zip_bg_stats AS (
  SELECT zbo.zip_code, zbo.overlap_ratio, zbc.bank_count,
         zbc.bank_count * zbo.overlap_ratio / SUM(zbo.overlap_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY zbo.zip_code) as distributed_banks
  FROM zip_bg_overlap zbo
  JOIN zip_bank_counts zbc ON zbo.zip_code = zbc.zip_code
)
SELECT zip_code, 
       SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(distributed_banks), COUNT(*)) as avg_concentration
FROM zip_bg_stats
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY avg_concentration DESC
LIMIT 1

joined AS (

    a.geo_id,

    a.median_income AS income_2011,
    b.median_income AS income_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE((b.total_pop - a.total_pop), a.total_pop) * 100 AS pop_pct_increase,

  ROUND(a.pop_pct_increase, 2) AS pop_pct_increase,
  a.income_2011,

  a.income_abs_increase,
  a.pop_rank,
  b.income_rank

  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM end_date) = 2017
    AND subscriber_type IN ('Customer', 'Subscriber')
  GROUP BY month_num

SELECT
  m.month_num,
  COALESCE(mu.customer_minutes_thousands, 0.0) AS customer_minutes_thousands,
  COALESCE(mu.subscriber_minutes_thousands, 0.0) AS subscriber_minutes_thousands,
  COALESCE(
    ABS(mu.customer_minutes_thousands - mu.subscriber_minutes_thousands),
    0.0
  ) AS abs_diff_thousands
FROM (SELECT 1 AS month_num UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 
      UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 
      UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12) m
LEFT JOIN monthly_usage mu ON m.month_num = mu.month_num

  WHERE trip_start_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' 
    AND trip_start_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
    AND company IS NOT NULL 
    AND company != ''
  GROUP BY trip_month, company
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_month,
    company,
    trip_count,
    LAG(trip_count) OVER (PARTITION BY company ORDER BY trip_month) AS prev_month_count
  FROM monthly_counts
),
increases AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_month,
    company,
    trip_count,
    prev_month_count,
    trip_count - prev_month_count AS increase
  FROM with_prev
  WHERE prev_month_count IS NOT NULL
),
max_increase_per_company AS (
  SELECT 
    company,
    increase,
    trip_month,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company ORDER BY increase DESC) as rn
  FROM increases
)
SELECT 
  company,
  increase,
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', trip_month) AS month
FROM max_increase_per_company
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY increase DESC

WITH distinct_minutes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) as trip_minutes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) BETWEEN 1 AND 50
),
minute_quantiles AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_minutes,
    NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY trip_minutes) as quantile_group
  FROM distinct_minutes
),
trip_with_group AS (
  SELECT 
    t.fare,
    CAST(t.trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) as trip_minutes,
    mq.quantile_group
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips` t
  JOIN minute_quantiles mq ON CAST(t.trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) = mq.trip_minutes
  WHERE t.trip_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(t.trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) BETWEEN 1 AND 50
)
SELECT 
  CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(MIN(trip_minutes) AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm to ', LPAD(CAST(MAX(trip_minutes) AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm') as time_range,
  COUNT(*) as total_trips,
  ROUND(AVG(fare), 2) as avg_fare
FROM trip_with_group
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY MIN(trip_minutes)

-- Find the user with the highest first gap month number
-- First gap month number = the first month within their activity span where they had no activity

WITH user_months AS (
  SELECT 
    `by` as user_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(timestamp), MONTH) as activity_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.hacker_news.full`
  WHERE timestamp <= TIMESTAMP('2024-09-10')
    AND `by` IS NOT NULL
    AND `by` != ''
  GROUP BY `by`, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(timestamp), MONTH)
),
user_range AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MIN(activity_month) as first_month,
    MAX(activity_month) as last_month,
    COUNT(*) as actual_months
  FROM user_months
  GROUP BY user_id
),
-- Filter to users with at least one gap
users_with_gaps AS (
  SELECT user_id, first_month, last_month, actual_months,
         (DATE_DIFF(last_month, first_month, MONTH) + 1) as expected_months
  FROM user_range
  WHERE (DATE_DIFF(last_month, first_month, MONTH) + 1) - actual_months > 0
),
-- For each user, find their first gap month number
-- This is expensive, so let's focus on users with many actual months (more likely to have high first gap)
-- First, get the top candidates by actual_months
top_candidates AS (
  SELECT user_id, first_month, last_month, actual_months, expected_months
  FROM users_with_gaps
  ORDER BY actual_months DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
-- Generate all months for each candidate's span and find first gap
all_months AS (
  SELECT user_id, first_month, last_month,
         GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(first_month, last_month, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) as month_arr
  FROM top_candidates
),
months_expanded AS (
  SELECT user_id, first_month, last_month, month,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY month) as month_number
  FROM all_months, UNNEST(month_arr) as month
),
-- Join with actual activity to find gaps
first_gaps AS (
  SELECT me.user_id, me.first_month, me.last_month, me.month, me.month_number
  FROM months_expanded me
  LEFT JOIN user_months um ON me.user_id = um.user_id AND me.month = um.activity_month
  WHERE um.activity_month IS NULL
),
-- Get the first gap (minimum month_number) for each user
user_first_gaps AS (
  SELECT user_id, MIN(month_number) as first_gap_month_number
  FROM first_gaps
  GROUP BY user_id
)
-- Find the user with the highest first gap month number
SELECT ufg.user_id, ufg.first_gap_month_number
FROM user_first_gaps ufg
ORDER BY ufg.first_gap_month_number DESC
LIMIT 1
