WITH filtered_targets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID as target_uniprot_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
  WHERE i.drugID = 157 
    AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
    AND (e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100)
    AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100)
),
all_tas_uniprot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe.uniprot_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pte ON pe.stable_id = pte.pe_stable_id
  WHERE pte.evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
uniprot_pathways AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe.uniprot_id, pte.pathway_stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pte ON pe.stable_id = pte.pe_stable_id
  WHERE pte.evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
pathways AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pte.pathway_stable_id as pathway_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pte
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON pte.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
  WHERE pte.evidence_code = 'TAS' AND p.lowest_level = TRUE
),
pathway_counts AS (
  SELECT pw.pathway_id, pv.name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN up.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprot_id FROM filtered_targets) THEN up.uniprot_id END) as a,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN up.uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprot_id FROM filtered_targets) THEN up.uniprot_id END) as c
  FROM pathways pw
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON pw.pathway_id = pv.stable_id
  LEFT JOIN uniprot_pathways up ON pw.pathway_id = up.pathway_stable_id
  GROUP BY pw.pathway_id, pv.name
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered_targets ft WHERE ft.target_uniprot_id IN (SELECT uniprot_id FROM all_tas_uniprot)) as total_targets,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_tas_uniprot) as total_universe
)
SELECT pc.pathway_id, pc.name,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    t.total_universe * POW(SAFE_CAST(pc.a * (t.total_universe - t.total_targets - pc.c) AS FLOAT64) - SAFE_CAST((t.total_targets - pc.a) AS FLOAT64) * SAFE_CAST(pc.c AS FLOAT64), 2),
    SAFE_CAST(pc.a + (t.total_targets - pc.a) AS FLOAT64) * 
    SAFE_CAST(pc.c + (t.total_universe - t.total_targets - pc.c) AS FLOAT64) * 
    SAFE_CAST(pc.a + pc.c AS FLOAT64) * 
    SAFE_CAST((t.total_targets - pc.a) + (t.total_universe - t.total_targets - pc.c) AS FLOAT64)
  ), 4) as chi_squared,
  pc.a as targets_in_pathway,
  t.total_targets - pc.a as targets_outside_pathway,
  pc.c as non_targets_in_pathway,
  t.total_universe - t.total_targets - pc.c as non_targets_outside_pathway
FROM pathway_counts pc
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH red_tee_transactions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT

    e.ecommerce.transaction_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` e

transaction_items AS (

    i.item_name,

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` e,

),
combined AS (

-- Final result: cohort date and Week 2 retention rate as percentage
WITH user_first_touch AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(user_first_touch_timestamp)) as first_touch_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
),
all_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
),
user_first_session AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, MIN(event_date) as first_session_date
  FROM all_sessions
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
new_users AS (
  SELECT ufs.user_pseudo_id
  FROM user_first_session ufs
  INNER JOIN user_first_touch uft ON ufs.user_pseudo_id = uft.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ufs.first_session_date) = uft.first_touch_date
),
user_cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    ufs.user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ufs.first_session_date), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ufs.first_session_date)) - 2) DAY) as cohort_week_start
  FROM user_first_session ufs
  INNER JOIN new_users nu ON ufs.user_pseudo_id = nu.user_pseudo_id
),
cohort_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_week_start,
    COUNT(*) as cohort_size
  FROM user_cohort
  WHERE cohort_week_start BETWEEN '2018-07-09' AND '2018-09-17'
  GROUP BY cohort_week_start
),
retained AS (
  SELECT 
    c.cohort_week_start,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_pseudo_id) as retained_count
  FROM user_cohort c
  INNER JOIN all_sessions s 
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = s.user_pseudo_id
    AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', s.event_date) = DATE_ADD(c.cohort_week_start, INTERVAL 14 DAY)
  WHERE c.cohort_week_start BETWEEN '2018-07-09' AND '2018-09-17'
  GROUP BY c.cohort_week_start
)
SELECT 
  cs.cohort_week_start,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(r.retained_count, 0), cs.cohort_size) * 100, 2) as week2_retention_rate
FROM cohort_sizes cs
LEFT JOIN retained r ON cs.cohort_week_start = r.cohort_week_start
ORDER BY cs.cohort_week_start

WITH session_traffic AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    event_date,
    (SELECT p.value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) p WHERE p.key = 'ga_session_id') as ga_session_id,
    traffic_source.medium as ts_medium,
    traffic_source.source as ts_source,
    traffic_source.name as ts_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN ts_source = '(direct)' AND ts_medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('baidu','bing','duckduckgo','ecosia','google','yahoo','yandex') 
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('baidu','bing','duckduckgo','ecosia','google','yahoo','yandex') 
           AND ts_medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('alibaba','amazon','google shopping','shopify','etsy','ebay','stripe','walmart')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('alibaba','amazon','google shopping','shopify','etsy','ebay','stripe','walmart')
           AND ts_medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_source, r'^(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)$')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_source, r'^(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)$')
           AND ts_medium IN ('social','social-network','social-media','sm','social network','social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('dailymotion','disneyplus','netflix','youtube','vimeo','twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('dailymotion','disneyplus','netflix','youtube','vimeo','twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'^(.*video.*)$') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN ts_medium IN ('display','banner','expandable','interstitial','cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN ts_medium = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN ts_medium = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN ts_medium = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN ts_source = 'sms' OR ts_medium = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'push$') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(ts_medium, r'mobile|notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN ts_source IN ('email','e-mail','e_mail','e mail') OR ts_medium IN ('email','e-mail','e_mail','e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN ts_medium = 'organic' AND ts_source NOT IN ('baidu','bing','duckduckgo','ecosia','google','yahoo','yandex') THEN 'Organic Search'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END as channel
  FROM session_traffic
)
SELECT 
  channel,
  COUNT(*) as session_count
FROM classified
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY session_count DESC

           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|.*ppc.*|.*paid.*') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|\^)shop|shopping).*)$'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|.*ppc.*|.*retargeting.*|.*paid.*') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'.*badoo.*|.*facebook.*|.*fb.*|.*instagram.*|.*linkedin.*|.*pinterest.*|.*tiktok.*|.*twitter.*|.*whatsapp.*')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|.*ppc.*|.*retargeting.*|.*paid.*') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*cp.*|.*ppc.*|.*retargeting.*|.*paid.*') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'cross-network') THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'push$|mobile|notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') 
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'.*video.*') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|\^)shop|shopping).*)$') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'.*badoo.*|.*facebook.*|.*fb.*|.*instagram.*|.*linkedin.*|.*pinterest.*|.*tiktok.*|.*twitter.*|.*whatsapp.*')
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM session_params
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS total_sessions
FROM classified
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC

    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') AS page_location,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT((SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location'), r'https?://[^/]+(.*)') AS path,
    SPLIT(REGEXP_EXTRACT((SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location'), r'https?://[^/]+(.*)'), '/') AS segments
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210128`
  WHERE user_pseudo_id = '1362228.4966015575'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    page_title,
    CASE 
      WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 4 
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(segments[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) - 1)], r'\+')
        AND (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(segments[OFFSET(1)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus.collection|drinkware|electronics|google.redesign|lifestyle|nest|new.2015.logo|notebooks.journals|office|shop.by.brand|small.goods|stationery|wearables)')
          OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(segments[OFFSET(2)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus.collection|drinkware|electronics|google.redesign|lifestyle|nest|new.2015.logo|notebooks.journals|office|shop.by.brand|small.goods|stationery|wearables)'))
      THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 4
        AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(segments[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) - 1)], r'\+')
        AND (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(segments[OFFSET(1)]), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus.collection|drinkware|electronics|google.redesign|lifestyle|nest|new.2015.logo|notebooks.journals|office|shop.by.brand|small.goods|stationery|wearables)')

deduped AS (
  SELECT display_page, grp, MIN(event_timestamp) AS first_ts
